direction: Daily time-series momentum with a fixed positive entry hurdle and zero-return exit; separate unlevered BTC and ETH cash accounts.
hypothesis: Published work reports daily/weekly cryptocurrency time-series momentum. Test a simple long-only, absolute return-threshold adaptation on Binance BTC/ETH; this is not a paper replication and does not assume the reported effect survives contemporary trading costs.

sources.citation: Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu, Risks and Returns of Cryptocurrency (NBER Working Paper 24877 / Review of Financial Studies, 2021).
sources.scope: Motivation only; their universe and sampling differ, and the current rule is not a replication.

rule.signal: On each newly closed UTC daily candle j, calculate ROC_L=close[j]/close[j-L]-1 using only that candle and the close L complete daily bars earlier.
rule.entry: If cash and ROC_L is strictly greater than the frozen entry hurdle, target long.
rule.exit: If long and ROC_L is less than or equal to zero, target cash. Between thresholds, keep the previous target. Equality at entry does not enter; equality at exit exits.
rule.execution: Signal becomes available at the signal candle close; if target changes, simulate an order at the next UTC day 00:01 one-minute open (60-second delay). Rejected orders are not backfilled; the same desired state may be tried on a later new daily decision. At the frozen OOS terminal timestamp, liquidate any open lot with costs.
rule.account: Independent 2,000 USDT single-asset cash account for every asset×parameter combination; all initial capital assigned to the specified asset sleeve, no leverage, borrowing, shorting, transfer or cash interest.

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 consecutive, non-overlapping 30-day evaluation windows; account remains continuous across windows; no fitting, parameter selection or fold reset.
time_boundaries.history_note: The 2025–2026 OOS window has been reused extensively in this repository and is not an untouched final holdout.

validation.neighborhood: Same asset, adjacent lookback index and adjacent hurdle index in the frozen 3×3 grid; 3×3 neighborhood including center.
validation.multiple_testing: No DSR/PBO claim: repeated reused-OOS history and many prior strategy trials create material selection bias.

costs.impact: 0.5 × sample stdev of previous 20 complete UTC daily log returns × sqrt(order quote budget / previous 20 complete daily quote ADV)
costs.filters_source: Fresh public Binance exchangeInfo GET body and derived current PRICE_FILTER/LOT_SIZE/NOTIONAL/PERCENT_PRICE rules; adverse tick rounding and lot floor; 5-minute pre-execution VWAP proxy. Historical L2 and historical exchange filters are unavailable.

data.format: Archived Binance spot 1m OHLCV; daily closes and quote ADV are aggregated from fully closed UTC days.

same_family_context: Daily EMA 5/10/20×40/80/160 crossover grid completed 2026-10-14 and rejected.
4h time-series momentum and volume-confirmed 4h momentum grids completed/rejected.
Long-horizon relative-strength, daily weekday calendar and multiple channel/MA grids are already in the registry.
prior_results.distinction: This rule uses daily cumulative simple close-to-close return with an absolute entry hurdle and zero ROC exit; it is a different full rule/timeframe from 4h momentum, cross-sectional relative strength and moving-average crosses.
